_comment: Compatibility (synastry) texts. {A} = your point's theme (capitalized), {b} = their point's theme, both from aspects.json ("your" becomes "their" for the other person). Tendencies, never a verdict.

templates.conjunction: {A} and {b} meet in the same place, so this part of your connection can feel strong and familiar.
templates.sextile: {A} and {b} support each other in a friendly way. A little effort can make this easy to build on.
templates.trine: {A} and {b} flow together naturally, which can make this part of your connection feel easy.
templates.square: {A} and {b} can rub against each other at times. Talking openly can turn the friction into growth.
templates.opposition: {A} and {b} sit on opposite sides, so you may balance each other or pull in different directions. Meeting in the middle can help.

bands.harmony: Where things may flow easily between you.
bands.growth: Where you may learn from each other, with patience and commitment.
bands.challenges: Where you may see things differently. Kindness and honest talk help most here.

intro: Every relationship has easy parts and harder parts. These patterns describe tendencies, not a verdict on whether you belong together.
respect: Healthy relationships are built on respect, trust and free choice, for both of you.
